text: You turned on your fucking AI auto-reply, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you.

text: Two seconds, bro. I'm upgrading the servers to make it one.
style: Proud and hyped, a casual American guy bragging to his buddy about his tech setup.

text: Cool. Now your leads leave in two seconds too.
style: Flat and deadpan, a beat after 'Cool', then a slow, cutting finish.
Offended and confused, a bit defensive.

text: Watch. Lead types, "hey." Bot: "How can I help?" Lead: "so I saw your..." Bot: "Here's my booking link!"
style: Playful and mocking, acting it out: a lazy, slow texter voice for the lead, a chirpy over-eager robot voice for the bot, quick back and forth.

text: Okay, they were kinda still typing.
style: Sheepish, a little embarrassed, trailing off.

text: They said "hey" and your bot already proposed.
style: A mocking roast, slow and smug, savoring the last word.

text: Then it asks their goal. They literally just told it.
style: Deflated, like a confession, rushing the second sentence.

text: That's not a chat, that's a form with emojis.
style: Dry and smug, a small beat before 'a form with emojis'.

text: Honestly, number one complaint I get? My AI answers instantly. So I slow it down?
style: Honest and tired at first, then a hopeful, slightly naive question.

text: Nope. Plug me into ManyChat. I wait till they're done typing, then send one reply, one question.
style: Smooth and sly, a beat after 'Nope', then calm and confident, a tiny beat before 'one reply, one question'.

text: I remember what they said. Same question twice? Never.
style: Proud and cocky, a short pause before 'Never'.

text: Okay. How do I set you up?
style: Hesitant and a bit sheepish, a small pause after okay.

text: First, leave the server room. You bought fucking servers so your bot could be wrong faster.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
